advisory.name: Java4Shell
advisory.flaw: memory corruption in the optimised Base64 decoder of OpenJDK (negative length on padding)
advisory.hardware: only x86-64 with AVX-512 VBMI (Intel Xeon Ice Lake and later, AMD Zen 4 and later); ARM64 is not affected
advisory.condition: the application passes attacker-controlled Base64 input to the decoder, for example HTTP Basic or SAML tokens
advisory.exploitation: denial of service is easy, remote code execution is hard; no public exploit and no known attack, first attempts seen by Greynoise
advisory.workaround: start the JVM with -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics or -XX:UseAVX=2, then restart it
advisory.mitigation: update to a fixed OpenJDK and restart the Java processes; restrict access to Java applications reachable from the internet
